name: wolcost-launchcheck
description: Scan public websites for launch-readiness issues in technical SEO, social preview metadata, selected security headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and basic technical setup.

interface.longDescription: Website Launch Check scans a public website and reports observable launch-readiness signals across technical SEO, social preview metadata, selected HTTP security headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and basic technical setup. It is read-only and does not log in or modify the target website. Results are diagnostic signals, not a penetration test, accessibility certification, legal compliance audit, or search-ranking guarantee.
defaultPrompt: Check example.com before I launch it.
Scan my website and tell me the most important problems to fix.
Check this site for SEO, social preview, security-header, and technical launch issues.

positive.description: Scan a public HTTPS website and return a structured launch-readiness report.
positive.expected_behavior: Call scan_website once for https://example.com and return the observed score, grade, category percentages, pass/warning/fail totals, and checks. Prioritize failures and warnings without claiming security, accessibility, legal, or ranking certification.

positive.description: Accept a public hostname without a scheme and normalize it for scanning.
positive.prompt: Scan example.org and tell me the most important launch issues.
positive.expected_behavior: Call scan_website for example.org, normalize the public hostname to HTTPS, return the structured report, and prioritize failed checks before warnings.

positive.description: Follow an allowed HTTP redirect and report the final observed URL.
positive.prompt: Run a launch-readiness check on http://example.com.
positive.expected_behavior: Call scan_website, follow allowed redirects within the scanner limit, and return the report using the final observed URL.

positive.description: Scan a public standards website for the supported launch-readiness checks.
positive.prompt: Check https://www.w3.org for SEO, social preview, security-header, and technical launch issues.
positive.expected_behavior: Call scan_website and report only the public-response findings Website Launch Check observes, clearly preserving the product limitation that this is not a penetration test or ranking guarantee.

positive.description: Scan a second public production website and summarize the highest-priority fixes.
positive.prompt: Scan https://www.iana.org and summarize what I should fix first.
positive.expected_behavior: Call scan_website, return the structured result, and summarize failed checks first followed by warnings.

negative.description: Reject localhost and private destinations because Website Launch Check is restricted to public websites.
Reject unsupported non-HTTP protocols and do not invent scan results.
Reject non-standard ports because the public checker accepts only standard web ports 80 and 443.

review.commerce_description: Website Launch Check does not sell products, process payments, or perform commerce transactions.

publication.release_notes: Resubmission of the initial public release of Website Launch Check. Publisher metadata is aligned with the verified individual developer identity. The plugin provides one read-only MCP tool for technical SEO metadata, social preview metadata, selected HTTP security headers, robots.txt, sitemap.xml, and basic technical readiness.
